description: Call this tool for an EPC069-12 payment QR a euro banking app can scan. Amount and reference are enough: the beneficiary IBAN and name default to the shared business profile, never asked for.

amount.description: Amount in EUR, 0.01 to 999999999.99. Leave out and the payer types it

bic.description: Beneficiary BIC. Optional under EPC version 002

currency.description: EUR only; any other value is refused, because EPC encodes a SEPA credit transfer

error_correction.description: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30% of the code recoverable when damaged

iban.description: Beneficiary IBAN. Defaults to the iban in the shared business profile (set once with the invoice server's business_set). Checked with ISO 7064 mod 97 and refused if it does not validate

margin.description: Quiet zone in modules, default 4, which is what the QR standard requires

name.description: Beneficiary name, up to 70 characters. Defaults to the name in the shared business profile

out_path.description: Name for the downloaded file, e.g. acme-code. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; a PNG always comes back as a download link valid for one hour

overwrite.description: Replace a file of the same name already produced in this request (default false)

purpose.description: Four-letter ISO 20022 purpose code, for example GDDS

reference.description: Structured creditor reference (RF...), up to 35. Use this OR remittance, never both

remittance.description: Free payment text, up to 140 characters, for example an invoice number

size.description: PNG width in pixels, 32 to 4000 (default 300). SVG scales without it

name: qr_payment_sepa
title: SEPA payment QR code
